providerId.description: Provider to validate the credential against.

credential.description: Credential payload to test. Must be one of the secret credential shapes (api_key / address / account_name) — empty objects not accepted here.

passphrase.description: The passphrase field for providers that need one (OKX, KuCoin, Bitget, OKCoin, Coinbase Pro/Prime, Poloniex Futures).

password.description: Legacy alias for `passphrase` — accepted for backwards compatibility with older clients, normalized into `passphrase` server-side.

address.description: IDEX only: the wallet address credential field.

privateKey.description: IDEX only: the wallet's private key (hex), required alongside apiKey/secret/address.

privateKeyPem.description: Fireblocks-only: RSA private key (PEM), used instead of secretKey.

oneOf.description: Credential shape for credentialKind `address` (read-only on-chain address).
oneOf.title: AddressCredential

workspaceId.description: If provided, the credential is checked against existing integrations in this workspace for the same provider — a matching credential (same address / accountName / apiKey) returns 409 instead of validating. Omit to skip the duplicate check.

skipDuplicateCheck.description: Set true to bypass the duplicate-credential check even when workspaceId is provided.
